'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Andrew Bollentino LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Bollentino]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Username:''' Lord Bane
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
